Trigger: A capture reports desktop users losing edits to sync conflicts.
Action if met: Reconsider building conflict-safe sync.

## Decision
Title: No cloud sync in version one
Choice: Ship version one without cloud sync; local files only.
Reasons:
- Avoid conflict handling until the core is stable.

## Revisit condition
Label: Skip rate
Trigger: A capture reports the history-ranked shuffle raising skip rate above 40%.
Action if met: Revert to random shuffle.

## Decision
Title: Rank shuffle by listening history
Choice: Order shuffle using each listener's history.
Reasons:
- Fewer skips in the prototype.
